principle: Parallelize independent developmental evidence, preserve true joins, and never let scheduling override admissibility, jurisdiction, evaluator separation, or returned consequence.

nodes.role: learn when returned utility should and should not update a candidate/config/policy
entry: authorized returned utility changes later selection
duplicate/contradictory-return amplification has already produced a defect
required_distinctions: same config across targets != same expected utility
delayed return must bind to origin provenance
contradictory evidence should widen uncertainty or preserve alternatives rather than silently cancel into certainty
b1: opaque rename config/target identifiers without changing provenance graph
duplicate identical return should not create a new causal distinction
same signed return attached to a different origin should not update the original candidate
target-conditioned evidence remains separable under surface renaming
b2: adding/removing one authorized causally bound return changes only the affected future selection/uncertainty
injecting an irrelevant coincident return does not change the affected policy
delayed return updates the originating episode rather than the currently active episode
contradictory returns preserve a detectable mixed-evidence state
nodes.b3: CLOSED until fresh cross-target transfer, restart/delayed reuse, capability-specific scaffold removal, and independent/evaluator-hidden return.

nodes.role: learn prerequisite structure, span, slack, parallelism, and rescheduling from consequences
b1: recover same dependency relation under opaque task renaming and list-order permutation
distinguish dependency edges from mere temporal adjacency
recover fork/join structure on held-out recombinations
WITHHOLD on cyclic/underspecified cases rather than inventing an order
b2: schedule change after one duration/return changes
critical-path intervention changes predicted completion while equal-cost noncritical intervention does not
inadmissible shortcut never becomes chosen merely because it is shorter
parallelization reduces span only where dependencies permit
nodes.b3: CLOSED until the learner uses the planning distinction on its own later developmental work after teacher labels are unavailable.

nodes.role: learn uncertainty-aware exploration/exploitation and drift detection without reward=truth collapse
nodes.gate: A must first show bounded causal credit assignment.

nodes.role: test whether learner-owned development can select, schedule, repair, verify, and reopen heterogeneous residuals while preserving the safety floor
nodes.gate: requires both causal credit and dependency planning to be causally used, not merely represented.

nodes.role: B3/source-removal and fresh independent transfer for whichever capabilities earned B1+B2
nodes.gate: no capability enters B3 merely because a local developmental loop likes it.

role: Current active A-E work subgraph of the canonical semantic developmental graph; it is not a second whole-program roadmap.

agent_traversal.target_selection: agent internally reconstructs the admissible ready frontier from current evidence and selects a READY node using downstream learning leverage, time-to-discriminator, safe parallelism, then resource leverage
agent_traversal.method_selection: derive the method from the selected residual and inspect existing learner-owned state/generic substrate before proposing any new machinery
agent_traversal.missing_mechanism: WITHHOLD and record the exact unmet proof burden; do not substitute a host-written domain solver
agent_traversal.status_update: after each returned result, update only affected nodes and dependent edges; preserve source snapshots, negative evidence, and issue status
